entries.prompt: Create ONE isolated transparent PNG collectible thumbnail for cozy aquarium game. A cute waterlogged apricot-orange swimming crab plush toy, broad flattened rounded crab shell with little side points, two soft stuffed claws, four pairs of short floppy legs including paddle-shaped rear feet. Cream belly, button eyes, stitched smile, visible brown seams and one cream repair patch. Match the provided octopus plush example's rounded shapes, warm dark-brown outlines, soft cel shading and worn fabric texture. The otter reference is ONLY the cartoon rendering style, never copy its anatomy or starfish. Full object fully visible centered, no base or scene, no extra animals, no words or labels, no checkerboard. Real alpha transparency. Longest silhouette fills roughly 82% canvas, generous transparent margins. Lovable slightly shabby toy found underwater, not a living animal or photorealistic product photo.
